subject.title: Feature: Surface cron job name / session label in /status and statusline

question: Should maintainers close or supersede the conflicting fork PR and sponsor a narrow terminal-safe status-label fix, or ask the fork PR author to rebase and prove that branch?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the issue has product-decision/no-new-fix-pr signals and an open conflicting linked PR based on a previously closed unmerged attempt.

options.title: Sponsor narrow fix
options.body: Keep this issue canonical, close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, and land a focused owner-reviewed fix with terminal-safe label rendering and raw-key fallback/detail.

options.title: Ask fork PR to rebase
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork PR author to rebase onto current main, add sanitization, and provide real behavior proof.

options.title: Fold into broader attribution
options.body: Defer this display change into the broader status/usage attribution design, accepting raw CLI/TUI status keys until that product shape is chosen.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrow fix
recommendation.body: Keep this issue canonical, close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, and land a focused owner-reviewed fix with terminal-safe label rendering and raw-key fallback/detail.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest available routing owner from recent status-helper and TUI/session-controller history, and this is a cross-surface product-shape choice.
